Name: Damage Overlay
Author: pepoluan
Description:
At first, I made this as a joke mod :P ... then it became clear that this mod is helpful as it visually, continually alerts the player that their farmer's health is low.

Install, and when your health drops below a certain threshold (configurable in config.json), the borders of the game field will become [color=#ff0000][b]red.[/b][/color]

As your health gets lower, the border becomes [color=#ff0000][b]redder[/b][/color].

Until you [s]die[/s] pass out due to loss of blood.

See [b]Video[/b] tab for demo.


[color=#ffff00][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Upgrading from v0.1.0[/size][/font][/b][/color]

Due to the amount of internal changes I made in v0.2.0, you'll have to [b]completely delete v0.1.0[/b] from your Mods folder, then extract the new one over. Sorry about that.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Temporarily Hide the Overlay (v0.7.0+)[/size][/font][/b]

So, you've hit really low health. You ran away. The overlay stays on screen. And it will stay there until you increase your HP above the predefined threshold levels.

Annoying? Of course.

So you can press [font=Courier New][color=#00ffff][b]OemSemicolon[/b][/color][/font] (the semicolon key, usually to the left of the Enter/Return key) to hide the overlay [i]temporarily[/i] ... if your health changes (up or down, doesn't matter), it will automagically appear again.

This hotkey is, of course, customizable via [color=#00ffff][b]config.json[/b][/color]. Just change the value for [font=Courier New]"[color=#00ffff]temp_hide_hotkey[/color]"[/font] to something of your liking.



[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Customization: Blood-vs-Haze[/size][/font][/b]

Open up [color=#00ffff][b]config.json[/b][/color] and change the value for [font=Courier New]"[color=#00ffff]overlay[/color]"[/font]. Two built-in 'overlay sets' are provided:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]"[color=#00ffff]simple[/color]"[/font] -- red haze border
[*][font=Courier New]"[color=#00ffff]bloody[/color]"[/font] -- blood droplets border <== THIS IS THE DEFAULT
[/list]
Since v0.8.1, you can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the overlay set from in-game.
If you want different overlays ... keep reading to the section "Customization: Your Own Overlay!"


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Customization: Health Level[/size][/font][/b]

If you think the border came too soon / too late, you can edit the Health% at which the border changes.

First, set the Blood-vs-Haze option as described above.

Then, go to the mod's folder, then into "assets", then into the option you chose in blood-vs-haze above.

Open the "overlay.json" file. Edit to your liking. The provided overlay.json files are commented so you should be able to intuit what each fields mean.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Customization: Your Own Overlay![/size][/font][/b]

Yes, you can use your own border graphics! There is only one requirement: The center area of the graphics you'll be using [i][b]must[/b][/i] be transparent. If not, you'll cover the game world!

There are 2 ways to do this: Modify the mod directly, or create a Content Pack.

[size=4][b][font=Trebuchet MS]Modify Mod Directly[/font][/b][/size]

Steps:
[list=1]
[*]Create a new folder under "assets", let's call this "my_border"
[*]Copy the PNG file you want to use into this new folder
[*]Copy "overlay.json" from "assets/simple" or "assets/bloody" into the new folder
[*]Edit the "overlay.json" to your liking
[*]Open the "config.json", edit the value for "overlay" to "my_border" (or whatever the name of the new folder you created in Step #1)
[*]Start Stardew Valley
[*]If you don't see Errors from "Damage Overlay" in the SMAPI Console, then you're done!
[/list]
To help you test your changes, a new console command " [font=Courier New]dover sethp <percentage>[/font] " have been implemented in v0.8.1.
[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]Create a Content Pack[/size][/font][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4] (for v0.6.0+)[/size][/font]

Or... create a Content Pack! Take a look at the provided "DamageOverlay ContentPack Example" file, and edit to your liking.
Then edit this mod's config.json to use the overlay name provided by your content pack.

To help you test your changes, a new console command " [font=Courier New]dover sethp <percentage>[/font] " have been implemented in v0.8.1
